title: Sirmione 4K Walking Tour — Lake Garda's Peninsula Town, Italy 🇮🇹

This 5.5-mile walk covers all of it — the old town piazzas, the lakefront and beaches, Jamaica Beach's rock shelves, the Grotte di Catullo Roman villa, and a full castle tour — with parking, train, through northern Italy. The Romans built grand holiday villas here — the most impressive of which, the Grotte di Catullo, still stands at the tip of the promontory and ranks as one of the largest Roman residential sites in all of northern Italy. In the 13th century, the Della Scala (Scaligeri) family of Verona built the Rocca Scaligera — a rare lake fortress with its own port — which still guards the only land entrance to the old town. The name Sirmione itself likely derives from the Latin "syrma," meaning a long trailing garment — a fitting description for this slender peninsula trailing into the lake.  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📽 MORE WALKING TOURS ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🎄Christmas Markets Playlist: (https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSOO4vYXpMCd2nqHyPaDtgxkf_BsAuQCt&si=0YU1zhv0tLbwm8u6) 🍕 Italy Playlist: (https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSOO4vYXpMCc6k7EuMhr764qCNeXDrxpj&si=aYfLAtNw1eGc560w) 🚴 Biking Tours Playlist: (https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSOO4vYXpMCe4SaQXMk9IMfpkl1w473Zz&si=1rFBHTnZtCMmykPA) 🌍 Complete List of Walks: http://www.prowalks.com/videos   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📢 SUPPORT & CONNECT 📢 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🌍 Website: https://www.prowalktours.com 📧 Email: info@prowalktours.com 🔔 Subscribe for more! title: Otranto, Italy 4K Walking Tour | Beautiful Old Town & Turquoise Sea
description: This 4K walking tour of Otranto, Italy was filmed on Sunday, July 19th, 2026 starting at 12:34 PM at the Spiaggetta del Molo, the little beach at the foot of the town walls. It was a hot market Sunday — 31°C (88°F), with the monthly Otranto Antiqua antiques market running all day along the waterfront — so the whole town was either at the beach or in the water. The 5 km (3 mile) route circles the beaches, the walled old town, the Cathedral with its famous 12th-century Tree of Life floor mosaic and the Chapel of the 800 Martyrs, the Aragonese Castle, the Byzantine church of San Pietro, and ends on the long sandy beaches across the bay. Otranto is the easternmost town in Italy — on a clear day you can see Albania across the strait. I first filmed Otranto back in 2021, and this summer I finally brought my family here to swim. You will see them a few times during the walk. :)  Watch the original 2021 tour here: https://youtu.be/SWDsHlHmnY4 An evening walking tour of Otranto is coming soon to the channel!  For the best experience, be sure to turn on closed captions [CC] and wear headphones 🎧 as you watch this tour. title: Venice, Italy Ultimate Walking Tour – Rialto, San Marco & Historic Venice | 4K 60fps
description: Venice Ultimate walking tour — Part 1 of a 7-hour walk through the historic center of Venice, Italy, starting at the Rialto Bridge and covering the Fish Market, Piazza San Marco, the Bridge of Sighs, Campo Santi Giovanni e Paolo, and countless hidden campos and canals off the tourist path. Filmed in 4K60fps with binaural audio.  Venice was built on 118 small islands in a saltwater lagoon and has been a UNESCO World Heritage site since 1987. This walk begins near the Rialto Bridge — completed in 1591 by Antonio da Ponte — and spends nearly 4 hours through the labyrinthine alleys, hidden campos, and working neighborhoods of San Marco, Castello, and Cannaregio.  Ideal for virtual travel, treadmill walks, and ambient atmosphere. Best with headphones.  ⭐ Don't miss: Rialto Bridge at 4:38, the Fish Market at 33:35, the Scenic Rooftop Terrace at 58:26, Piazza San Marco at 1:31:55, St. Mark's Campanile view at 1:41:17, the Bridge of Sighs at 2:03:52, the Amazing Book Store (Libreria Acqua Alta) at 2:47:26, and the grocery store inside an old theater at 3:49:12.  📅 Filmed on: Saturday, July 2nd, 2022 at 10:50 AM 🌞 Weather: 32°C | 90°F 📍 Location: Venice, Veneto Region, Italy 🗺️ Map of the Walk: https://www.google.com/maps/d/edit?mid=14X7n1movkk-1Sko5mBbcqGDKb5T46zI&usp=sharing  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⏱️ TOUR TIMELINE ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 0:00 Intro and Map ⭐ 4:38 Rialto Bridge and Canal Walk 26:58 Venetian Mask Shop ⭐ 33:35 Fish Market 44:22 Campo Erberia 51:56 Rialto Bridge ⭐ 58:26 Scenic Rooftop Terrace 1:16:25 San Salvador Church ⭐ 1:31:55 Piazza San Marco ⭐ 1:41:17 St. Mark's Campanile View ⭐ 2:03:52 Bridge of Sighs 2:04:33 Waterfront Walk 2:15:00 Hidden Heart 2:26:10 Campo San Zaccaria 2:28:39 Campo Santi Filippo e Giacomo 2:29:59 Ponte de Canonica 2:34:36 Calle Larga S. title: 🇮🇹 Sirmione, Lake Garda Italy: The Town That Made Me Forget Everything Else!
description: Beneath this tiny Italian town, 70°C Roman springs still flow — and opera legend Maria Callas once called it home.  Join me on a walk through Sirmione, one of the most charming towns on Lake Garda — Italy's largest lake. We'll cross the drawbridge into the medieval Castello Scaligero, wander the narrow pedestrianised streets lined with cafés and flowers, cool off by the water, and soak up centuries of Roman and medieval history packed into this tiny peninsula.  🏰 A few facts about Sirmione: Sirmione sits on a narrow, 4 km peninsula jutting into Lake Garda — some say its name comes from the Greek word "syrma," meaning "tail," a nod to its elongated shape. The Castello Scaligero was built in the 13th–14th century by the Della Scala family, who ruled Verona for over a century, and it's the only medieval castle in Italy with its own harbour still enclosed within the walls. Beneath the town, sulphurous thermal springs rise from the lake bed at around 70°C — the same waters the Romans once used, and which still feed Sirmione's spas today. The town was also home to the legendary opera singer Maria Callas, and its historic centre is entirely pedestrianised, so the only way to see it properly is on foot — exactly what we're doing today.   🎬 Filming Info: 📍 Location: Sirmione, Italy 🇮🇹 📽️ Format: 4K HDR at 60fps 🎧 Audio: Real city sounds – no music, no commentary ☀️ Time: Daytime  👉 If you enjoyed this walk through Sirmione, please like and subscribe for more relaxing 4K walking tours from beautiful destinations across Italy and beyond. 💬 Which spot would you visit first — the castle, the cafés, or the lake? An ancient stone bridge offering picturesque views of the canals and traditional Suzhou architecture. 19. **Suzhou Pingtan Museum:** A museum dedicated to the traditional Suzhou performing art of Pingtan, featuring music, storytelling, and opera. 20. **Beisi Pagoda:** A historic pagoda offering stunning views of Suzhou and its surrounding landscapes. title: UPDATE! Universal Orlando Resort! CityWalk And Halloween Horror Nights!
description: **Universal Orlando Resort** is a major theme park destination in Orlando, Florida, featuring four parks: **Universal Studios Florida**, **Islands of Adventure**, the newer **Epic Universe** (opened 2025), and the water park **Volcano Bay**.  ### Parks Overview - **Universal Studios Florida**: Movie-themed with Diagon Alley (Harry Potter), Minion Land, Hollywood themes. Key rides: Harry Potter and the Escape from Gringotts, Transformers, Revenge of the Mummy. - **Islands of Adventure**: Adventure-focused with Hogsmeade (Harry Potter), Marvel Super Hero Island, Jurassic Park, Toon Lagoon. Highlights: Hagrid’s Magical Creatures Motorbike Adventure, The Incredible Hulk Coaster, Jurassic World VelociCoaster. - **Epic Universe**: Newest park with Ministry of Magic (Harry Potter), Isle of Berk (How to Train Your Dragon), Dark Universe, Celestial Park, and Super Nintendo World. Standouts: Stardust Racers, other high-thrill coasters. - **Volcano Bay**: Tropical water park with slides, lazy river, wave pool. Note: Seasonal closures (e.g., after Oct 2026) and cashless.  **Wizarding World of Harry Potter** spans lands in all three dry parks—Park-to-Park access is essential for full experience (Hogwarts Express connects USF & IOA).  ### Tickets & Practical Info (2026) - **Multi-day tickets** recommended: 3+ day Park-to-Park now includes Epic Universe hopping. Deals like "Buy 3 Get 2 Free" often available. - **Universal Express** skips lines (Unlimited with some on-site hotels; note exclusions like Hagrid’s after July 2026). - **On-site hotels** (11 options): Early Park Admission (1 hour), free transport (walking, water taxi, buses), some include Express. Tiers from Value to Signature (e.g., Hard Rock). - **CityWalk**: Free entertainment/dining/shopping hub.  ### Tips - Stay on-site for perks. Buy tickets in advance. Use app for mobile ordering, wait times. - Best times: Weekdays, avoid peak holidays. Plan for crowds in new Epic Universe. - 3+ days ideal; prioritize rope drop or Express for thrill rides. - Special events: Mardi Gras, Halloween Horror Nights, Holidays.  **Budget note**: Multi-day trip for family of 4 can be $5k+ including hotel/tickets (varies). title: 🇬🇧 LONDON WALK 🔥 37°C in CROWDED Central London! Oxford Street, Soho & Covent Garden | 4K
description: 🇬🇧 London Walk | London Heatwave 2026 | Oxford Street | 37°C in London | West End Walk | 4K. Join me on a London walking tour during the 5th heatwave of the summer, with temperatures reaching 37°C!  I start this walk on Oxford Street, one of London’s most famous and busiest shopping streets, before heading towards Tottenham Court Road and into the heart of Soho. From there, I continue through Chinatown, Leicester Square and finally into beautiful Covent Garden.  I chose to start on Oxford Street because I could take the air-conditioned Elizabeth line all the way to Bond Street, giving me a much-needed cool start before heading out into the heat. As I walk through central London, the sun is behind me, so thankfully it isn't beating directly into my face while I'm walking.  Along the way, I pass some of London's most popular areas for visitors:  📍 Oxford Street – One of the world's most famous shopping streets, packed with major stores, restaurants and shoppers.  📍 Tottenham Court Road – A major central London street connecting Oxford Street with Soho and known for shopping, restaurants and its excellent transport connections.  📍 Soho – One of London's liveliest neighbourhoods, famous for its restaurants, bars, nightlife, independent shops and colourful streets.  📍 Chinatown – London's vibrant Chinatown, filled with Chinese restaurants, bakeries, shops and the famous Chinatown Gate.  📍 Leicester Square – One of London's major entertainment hubs, surrounded by cinemas, theatres, restaurants and attractions. It's also right next to the famous West End.  📍 Covent Garden – One of London's most popular tourist destinations, known for its beautiful market buildings, street performers, restaurants, shops and lively atmosphere.  And the journey home turned into another adventure! 😅 On the way back, we got stuck inside Russell Square station for around 20 minutes because the train ahead of us had broken down. With the heat outside, the temperature inside the station quickly became uncomfortable and everyone was sweating while waiting for the train to move again.  This was the 5th heatwave of the summer, making this another very hot day for exploring London on foot. description: Welcome To Rome!  Experience Rome step by step: impressive sights, hidden corners, and the unique flair of the Eternal City. A tour full of history, atmosphere, and true dolce vita.   1. Fountain Trevi   The Trevi Fountain, one of the city's most famous and iconic monuments, was designed and completed in the 18th century. Tourists come to the fountain to throw a coin into it, which, according to local legend, brings good luck. It also gained fame as it appeared in a key scene of Federico Fellini's 1960 film "La Dolce Vita".  2. Via del Corso   The Via del Corso, formerly known as Via Lata, is one of Rome's busiest, largest, and most important streets. It is one of the few perfectly straight streets in the city and is home to numerous monuments, palaces, hotels, restaurants, shops, and other businesses.  3. Pantheon   It is a classic building in the city, originally built by Marcus Agrippa as a temple to all the gods of ancient Rome and rebuilt in the early 2nd century AD. A near-contemporary writer, Cassius Dio, suggests that the name derives from the numerous statues of gods that surrounded the building, or from the resemblance of the dome to the sky.  4. Piazza Navona   One of the city's most famous squares, or piazzas, is known for its impressive Renaissance and Baroque architecture, numerous beautiful buildings, monuments and churches, as well as countless open-air bars, pizzerias, restaurants, cafes, stalls and artists. title: FLORENCE ITALY ✨ Markets & Shopping streets 4K Walking tour / Stroll asmr
description: Florence as it is, without embellishment. Awesome walking tour of Florence .  Mercato Centrale is absolutely worth visiting for its vibrant energy and massive variety of Italian and international foods. However, because it is a bustling, tourist-heavy food hall, your experience will depend on which section you visit and what you are looking for.  Is the statue of David in Florence a replica? In 1873, the statue was moved to the Galleria dell'Accademia, Florence. In 1910 a replica was installed at the original site on the public square. The biblical figure David was a favoured subject in the art of Florence.  The Piazza della Signoria (Signoria Square) is Florence's main square. It is located between the Piazza del Duomo and the Arno River. During the Roman Empire, the square had thermal baths, but these were abandoned at the beginning of the Middle Ages and the square was gradually taken over by artisans.  Lorenzo Ghiberti's Gates of Paradise The 17-foot-tall gilded doors, weighing 4 1/2 tons, are casts of the original doors created in the 15th-century workshop of sculptor Lorenzo Ghiberti for the east facade of the Baptistery of the Duomo (cathedral) in Florence, Italy.  What is Florence famous for? Florence, capital of Italy’s Tuscany region, is home to many masterpieces of Renaissance art and architecture. One of its most iconic sights is the Duomo, a cathedral with a terracotta-tiled dome engineered by Brunelleschi and a bell tower by Giotto. The Galleria dell'Accademia displays Michelangelo’s “David” sculpture. The Uffizi Gallery exhibits Botticelli’s “The Birth of Venus” and da Vinci’s “Annunciation".  How much is a cup of coffee in Florence? Paired with the discovery that Italian coffee is incredibly cheap (an espresso typically costs 1.10€-1.50€ while a cappuccino is like, 1.70€-2.00€), you can start off your day with a very Italian breakfast like a true local.  Enjoy your walk in Florence! title: 4K Sunny Day Walk in a Tropical Forest - Jungle Trails of Hawaii Tropical Botanical Garden
description: Aloha! Welcome to our virtual walking tour of the tropical paradise of Hawaii. Get ready to relax and rejuvenate as you embark on a journey through lush jungle trails and breathtaking greenery. Let the sights and sounds of nature soothe your senses as you immerse yourself in the gentle melodies of tropical birds and the calm rush of waterfalls. Our jungle walking tour will transport you to an enchanting oasis where you'll witness the healing power of nature firsthand. Prepare to be blown away by breathtaking views of the ocean, all from the comfort of your own home. This 4K virtual journey guarantees a feeling of tranquility, beauty, and calm, leaving you refreshed and inspired. Join us as we bring the Hawaii Tropical Botanical Garden to life on your 4K UHD screen. Get ready to witness the wonders of nature in mesmerizing 4K UHD resolution, and let the charm of Hawaii transport you to a place of serenity and awe.   The Tropical Botanical Garden on the Big Island is the perfect retreat for nature lovers, green-thumbed enthusiasts, and anyone seeking a tranquil escape. Spanning a whopping 17 acres, this garden is home to over 2,000 species of tropical flora, from native plants to exotic fruit trees and orchids. Nestled in Papaikou, Hawaii, the garden boasts a natural greenhouse that protects its lush vegetation from pesky trade winds. And with fertile volcanic soil, the garden's bioreserve is bursting with life, representing an impressive 125 families and 750 genera.  But this isn't just any garden. It's also a research and conservation center dedicated to preserving and studying tropical plants and their ecosystems. From the palm garden to the orchid house, the parrot pavilion to the Onomea Bay Trail, this garden has something for everyone- even photography enthusiasts looking to capture the perfect shot!  When our filmmaker Roman Khomlyak set out to film the Hawaii botanical garden for his latest virtual walking tour, he knew he was in for a treat. Armed with his trusty Panasonic GH6 and shooting at a stunning 4K 120fps, he captured the lush foliage and exotic plants with breathtaking detail. And for those unable to make the trip themselves, this 4K virtual tour offers a convenient way to explore the beauty of this tropical paradise from the comfort of their own homes. The Hawaii Tropical Botanical Garden, situated on the Big Island, is a perfect haven for nature and plant enthusiasts, as well as anyone seeking a peaceful retreat. The natural greenhouse, along with the fertile volcanic soil, nurtures a thriving bioreserve that represents 125 families and 750 genera of plant life. What was once a small village, and later a former sugarcane plantation, was replaced by stunning plants brought in by Dan Lutkenhouse Sr. from all over the world! The creator of the reserve set himself the goal of creating a unique place where both unique plants of their kind and those familiar to the Hawaiian Islands will be collected. And today, the Hawaiian Tropical Botanical Garden is not just a nature reserve. This is a place that teaches, and gives strength, beauty, and inspiration! title: MONTE CARLO, MONACO 🇲🇨 One Day in the Billionaire's Playground | 4K Walking Tour
description: This 4K Monaco walking tour takes you through the luxurious streets and famous landmarks of Monaco and Monte-Carlo, one of the most exclusive destinations in the world. Filmed in real time with no music and no commentary, this immersive Monaco walk captures luxury cars, elegant architecture, stunning Mediterranean views, and the unique atmosphere of the French Riviera city-state.  In this video, I show you Casino Square and the legendary Casino de Monte-Carlo, surrounded by luxury hotels, supercars, and some of the most famous buildings in Monaco. The area feels polished, elegant, and instantly recognizable.  I also walk parts of the iconic Formula 1 Monaco Grand Prix street circuit, including sections with grandstands and famous corners used during one of the most prestigious races in motorsport. Even without the race, these streets already feel legendary.  As the walk continues, I head toward higher areas of Monaco using stairways leading to incredible viewpoints overlooking the harbor, yachts, and skyline. The elevation changes reveal just how dramatic Monaco’s landscape really is.  You’ll also see the Prince’s Palace of Monaco (Palais Princier) located in Monaco-Ville, the historic old town built on top of the rock. title: Typhoon Heavy Rain Walk in Tokyo getting completely soaked | Japan 4K HDR ASMR
description: Experience Typhoon Jangmi and record-breaking heavy rain in Tokyo with this immersive morning walk from Hakusan Station to Kasuga Station. Walking through the empty backstreets for over an hour and a half left us completely soaked to the waist, capturing the beautiful, raw texture of this historic storm.  Use these intense rain sounds and city ambiance as a relaxing soundscape to help you sleep, study, meditate, and relax. A perfect 90-minute Tokyo ASMR journey for those who love the real and rare atmosphere of Japan. Filmed in 4K HDR with high-quality immersive binaural audio. Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more Tokyo walking tours. title: 25 September 2026 PARIS 🇫🇷 FRANCE SECRET WALK TOUR CITY TOUR PARIS ARTS ET METIERS NARROW STREET SEE
description: 🇫🇷 Paris, France — Arts et Métiers  3rd Arrondissement | September 2026  Step away from the grand boulevards and discover a quieter side of Paris in Arts et Métiers, where every narrow street seems to hold a little secret.  Here, in the heart of the 3rd arrondissement, old Paris reveals itself through elegant stone façades, colorful doors, tiny passages, historic workshops, and peaceful corners hidden just beyond the busy streets. The atmosphere feels wonderfully authentic — a place where you can wander without a strict plan and simply let Paris unfold around you.  In September, the city has a particularly beautiful rhythm. The warm afternoon light touches the limestone buildings, café terraces begin to fill, bicycles glide quietly through the streets, and the sound of footsteps echoes along the narrow pavements.  Around Rue du Vertbois, Rue Chapon, Rue Volta, Rue des Gravilliers, and the small streets surrounding the Musée des Arts et Métiers, you can discover a fascinating mixture of medieval traces, 19th-century Paris, creative workshops, independent boutiques, cafés, and everyday neighborhood life.  One of the pleasures of walking here is looking upward. Behind the familiar Parisian façades are unexpected architectural details — carved decorations, old signs, iron balconies, weathered shutters, and tiny windows that tell stories of another Paris.  And then, suddenly, you may turn into a quiet corner where the city seems to slow down.  No famous monument. No grand avenue. Just an old doorway, a little café, sunlight on the pavement, and the gentle feeling of being somewhere most visitors simply walk past.  That is the magic of Arts et Métiers.  It is not Paris as a postcard. It is Paris as a neighborhood — intimate, elegant, imperfect, historic, and alive.  So take your time. Walk slowly. Look through the small passages, pause at the corners, listen to the sounds of the street, and let yourself get a little lost.  Because sometimes the most beautiful Paris is found between the famous places.

description: Discover Utrecht on foot in this relaxing walking tour through the historic center of one of the Netherlands' oldest cities. We pass Utrecht University buildings, explore hidden gardens like Pandhof van de Dom, and walk along the scenic Oudegracht canal, where locals enjoy the sun, kayaks float by, and cellar-level terraces line the water.  We continue through medieval streets like Bakkerstraat, past the Dom Tower and Domplein, spot the statue of Pope Adrian VI, and visit the Pieterskerk and Bruntenhof courtyard.   Along the way, we learn about Utrecht’s famous residents, Dutch traditions, street art, and unique sights like the Miffy traffic light.   From the modern bubble roof at Utrecht Central Station to the quiet charm of Nieuwegracht, this Utrecht walking tour captures the city’s story through every step. title: New York / At night walk through Manhattan / NYC 4К
description: A real-time evening walk through Midtown Manhattan, beginning on 57th Street near 5th Avenue and continuing east to Park Avenue before heading south through one of New York City's most elegant neighborhoods.  📅 Date: June 22, 2026 🌡 Weather: 72°F (about +22°C) 🌙 9:00 PM • Warm summer night  This walk captures Manhattan after sunset, when the daytime crowds begin to disappear and the city takes on a completely different atmosphere. Office towers glow with thousands of lights, luxury hotels welcome evening guests, and Park Avenue becomes one of the most elegant streets in New York. Filmed in real time with natural sound, this walk showcases Midtown at night, where historic landmarks, modern skyscrapers, and beautifully illuminated streets create one of the city's most unforgettable evening experiences. 🎥 Real-time walk 🔇 No talking — natural NYC ambient sounds 🚶 Walking tour in 4K  🏛️ Interesting Facts About the Route The walk begins near 57th Street, often called Billionaires' Row, home to some of the tallest and most expensive residential skyscrapers in the world. This section of Midtown is also known for luxury hotels, flagship designer stores, concert venues, and world-famous architecture. As the route reaches Park Avenue, the atmosphere changes noticeably. Park Avenue was originally built above the tracks of the New York and Harlem Railroad. During the late 19th and early 20th centuries, the tracks were covered, creating the landscaped boulevard that has become one of Manhattan's most prestigious addresses. The avenue is famous for its wide, tree-lined median filled with seasonal flowers, public sculptures, and carefully maintained landscaping that changes throughout the year. Many of the buildings along Park Avenue were constructed during New York's post-war building boom and today serve as headquarters for major international companies, luxury hotels, and financial institutions. At night, the avenue becomes especially beautiful as office towers, historic buildings, and elegant lighting create one of the most cinematic walks in Midtown Manhattan.  ☕ SUPPORT THE CHANNEL If you enjoy real-time NYC walking videos and want to support future walks around New York City: Buy Me a Coffee: https://www.buymeacoffee.com/olfocus⁠ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/olfocusnyc⁠  ▶️ SUBSCRIBE More real-time walks around New York City: https://www.youtube.com/olfocus⁠ Your support helps the channel grow 🤍

title: Málaga Night Walk 4K 🇪🇸 | Experience the Nightlife of Costa del Sol
description: Join me for a night walk through the beautiful city center of Málaga, Spain, with lively streets, busy restaurants and the wonderful nightlife of the Costa del Sol. 🇪🇸  One of the things I really like about Málaga is how much life there is in the streets, even late in the evening. People are still out enjoying dinner, meeting friends or just walking around. I love evenings like this, when you don't really need a plan and can just enjoy being outside.  During this walk, I also came across something I wasn't expecting. There were lots of tents set up in Plaza de la Constitución as part of a protest about housing prices and the right to affordable housing. It was interesting to see this side of the city too.  I filmed this walk in Málaga, Spain, on Wednesday, October 7, 2026, at around 9:59 PM. It was still a lovely warm night with a temperature of about 23°C (73°F).  I hope you enjoy this night walk as much as I enjoyed filming it!  If you enjoyed the walk, please leave a like 👍 and subscribe for more walking videos from Spain and beyond. title: Nice, France 🇫🇷 Evening Walking Tour | Vieux Nice & Promenade des Anglais | 4K 60fps
description: Nice evening walk through Place Masséna, Fontaine du Soleil, Vieux Nice, Cours Saleya, and the Quai des États-Unis — 2.4-mile walk along the French Riviera in Nice, France. Filmed in 4K60fps with binaural audio.  One of the most beautiful evening walks in Europe, Nice comes alive at dusk as the summer heat fades and the cafés fill. This walk begins at Place Masséna and the controversial Fontaine du Soleil, heads along the Mediterranean seafront on Quai des États-Unis (the eastern continuation of the Promenade des Anglais), then climbs into the colorful lanes of Vieux Nice, Cours Saleya, and Place Rossetti.  Ideal for virtual travel, treadmill walks, and ambient atmosphere. Best with headphones.  ⭐ Don't miss: Fontaine du Soleil at 3:48, the Quai des États-Unis seafront at 14:18, Cours Saleya at 21:47, and Place Rossetti in Vieux Nice at 31:58.  📅 Filmed on: Monday, September 8th, 2025 | 6:59 PM 🌞 Weather: 29°C | 85°F 📍 Location: Nice, Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, France 📏 Distance: 2.4 Miles 🗺️ Map of the Walk: https://www.google.com/maps/d/edit?mid=1oS9dh052hHDnS0aF4ZlWcpk7mDKxCl4&usp=sharing  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⏱️ TOUR TIMELINE ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 0:00 Intro and Map ⭐ 0:53 Place Masséna (main square, constructed 1832–1850) ⭐ 3:48 Fontaine du Soleil (Apollo statue by Alfred Janniot, 1956) 7:50 Esplanade Georges Pompidou 9:59 Plage Beau Rivage ⭐ 14:18 Quai des États-Unis (Mediterranean seafront) ⭐ 21:47 Place Charles Félix (Cours Saleya) 26:08 Vieux Nice (Old Town) ⭐ 31:58 Place Rossetti 40:06 Place Saint-François 45:05 Le Ban Thai musicians 52:10 Porte Fausse 56:02 Place du Palais de Justice 59:15 Le Café du Palais live band 1:01:30 Place Charles Félix (Cours Saleya) 1:18:55 Quai des États-Unis 1:28:08 Cadran Solaire sundial 1:29:47 Camera Gear  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🌅 ABOUT NICE ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Nice sits on the Baie des Anges along the French Riviera, founded by Greek sailors around 350 BC as Nikaia. Place Masséna, the city's central square, was constructed between 1832 and 1850 on arcades covering the Paillon River. At its southern end stands the Fontaine du Soleil, featuring a 7-meter marble Apollo by sculptor Alfred Janniot surrounded by five bronze figures representing Earth, Mars, Venus, Mercury, and Saturn. Inaugurated in 1956, the Apollo was controversial enough to be removed in the 1970s and only restored to the square in 2011. title: ROME ITALY 🇮🇹 Vatican 4K Walking Tour Iconic Sights, Streets & Atmosphere with Ambient Sound asmr
description: Vatican City is a landlocked sovereign city-state in Southern Europe. Ruled by the pope, it is an enclave within the city of Rome, Italy, and serves as the administrative centre of the Catholic Church. Vatican City is governed by the See of Rome, commonly known as the Holy See, itself a sovereign entity under international law, which maintains its temporal power, governance, diplomacy, and spiritual independence. Vatican is also used as a metonym for the Holy See, which is the central governing body of the Catholic Church and Vatican City, comprising the pope and the Roman Curia.  Welcome To Rome!  Experience Rome step by step: impressive sights, hidden corners, and the unique flair of the Eternal City. A tour full of history, atmosphere, and true dolce vita.   1. Fountain Trevi   The Trevi Fountain, one of the city's most famous and iconic monuments, was designed and completed in the 18th century. Tourists come to the fountain to throw a coin into it, which, according to local legend, brings good luck. It also gained fame as it appeared in a key scene of Federico Fellini's 1960 film "La Dolce Vita".  2. Via del Corso   The Via del Corso, formerly known as Via Lata, is one of Rome's busiest, largest, and most important streets. It is one of the few perfectly straight streets in the city and is home to numerous monuments, palaces, hotels, restaurants, shops, and other businesses.  3. Pantheon   It is a classic building in the city, originally built by Marcus Agrippa as a temple to all the gods of ancient Rome and rebuilt in the early 2nd century AD. A near-contemporary writer, Cassius Dio, suggests that the name derives from the numerous statues of gods that surrounded the building, or from the resemblance of the dome to the sky.  4. Piazza Navona   One of the city's most famous squares, or piazzas, is known for its impressive Renaissance and Baroque architecture, numerous beautiful buildings, monuments and churches, as well as countless open-air bars, pizzerias, restaurants, cafes, stalls and artists. title: 【4K】🇨🇦 TORONTO NIGHT WALK 🌃 | Cold & Windy Autumn Downtown Streets (October 2026)
description: 🇨🇦 Explore Downtown Toronto at Night in 4K on a chilly Friday night, walking along Bay Street, Front Street West, John Street, Queen Street West, Spadina Avenue, and King Street West. 🌃 Experience the real Toronto nightlife, glowing city lights, stunning CN Tower night views, towering skyscrapers, and the cold, windy atmosphere of an October night in Canada's largest city. Toronto felt very different on this Friday night. The temperature dropped quickly after sunset, the wind picked up, and the damp autumn air brought a serious chill to the downtown streets. title: Munich, Germany City Walking Tour | Summer Vibes 4K
description: Experience Munich in summer on this 4K city walking tour through the historic old town of Munich, Germany, with Marienplatz, Odeonsplatz, Neuhauser Street, Karlstor, Residenzstrasse and Am Platzl. This Munich walking tour captures summer vibes in Bavaria’s capital with lively pedestrian streets, historic squares, Bavarian architecture, street cafés, old city gates, royal landmarks and the classic atmosphere of Munich city centre.  Munich is one of Germany’s most recognisable city destinations because its historic centre brings together medieval streets, royal architecture, shopping areas, traditional squares and Bavarian urban life in a compact walking route. This summer walk shows the city centre at street level: people moving through the old town, cafés and shops along the pedestrian zone, historic façades around Marienplatz, and the elegant route towards Odeonsplatz and the Residenz area. Where even the gardens, monuments, buildings, and streets are, in many cases, veritable masterpieces. Walking down the streets of Florence is like walking through the halls of a big open air museum. However, even if the outdoors has so much to offer, don’t forget that Florence is home to some of the most important ‘indoor museums’ in the world! The Uffizi museum, for example, is famous all around the globe (the ‘Primavera del Botticelli’ alone is worth a visit to the city) and the Galleria dell’Accademia has a wonderful gallery of statues, among them the Michelangelo’s world-celebrated David, among many more! Remember, Florence city center is listed as World Heritage site by UNESCO. So don't ask a Florentine citizen "how far is Tuscany from Florence?" because Florence is Tuscany in the world. title: OSLO, Norway 🇳🇴 This Is Nordic Wealth | 4K Walking Tour
description: This 4K Oslo walking tour takes you through the heart of Norway’s capital, exploring modern architecture, vibrant city streets, waterfront districts, royal landmarks, and quiet residential neighborhoods. The walk continues through the area around Oslo Central Station (Oslo Sentralstasjon) before reaching Karl Johans Gate, the city's most famous boulevard. Along the way, I explore Oslo’s city center, the area around Nationaltheatret, and the grand approach to the Royal Palace (Det Kongelige Slott), the official residence of the Norwegian monarch. Surrounded by beautiful parkland and elegant avenues, it is one of the city's most important landmarks.  Beyond the major attractions, the tour also ventures into quieter residential streets, showcasing another side of Oslo that many visitors never see. description: Enjoy a relaxing lunchtime walk through Greenwich Village, Manhattan, on a beautiful sunny day in October. ☀️🍂  On October 12, 2026, the temperature reached 73°F (23°C), creating perfect conditions for exploring the historic streets of one of New York City's most beloved neighborhoods.  Our walk takes us along West 12th Street, West 10th Street, and West 8th Street, with views around Fifth Avenue and Sixth Avenue. Discover the neighborhood's historic architecture, charming residential streets, local businesses, and the everyday rhythm of downtown Manhattan.  🏙️ DISCOVER GREENWICH VILLAGE  Greenwich Village has long been associated with New York's artistic, literary, and cultural life. Its distinctive street layout, historic buildings, and lively public spaces make it feel different from the city's towering business districts.  A few interesting facts about Greenwich Village:  • A different street layout: Many Village streets follow older routes rather than Manhattan's regular grid, creating unusual intersections and charming corners.  • Washington Square Park: One of the neighborhood's best-known landmarks, the park is famous for its marble arch and central fountain. It has long been a gathering place for students, artists, musicians, and local residents.  • A creative history: Greenwich Village became an important center for writers, musicians, artists, and the bohemian movements of the 20th century.  • Historic character: The neighborhood is known for its rows of townhouses, older apartment buildings, and streets that preserve much of New York's architectural history.  🎥 ABOUT THIS WALK  📍 Location: Greenwich Village, Manhattan, New York City 📅 Date: October 12, 2026 🌤️ Weather: Sunny, 73°F / 23°C 🚶 Route: West 12th Street, West 10th Street, West 8th Street, Fifth Avenue, and Sixth Avenue 🎧 No talking, just authentic NYC street sounds 📺 Filmed in 4K  Put on your headphones and enjoy the sights and sounds of Greenwich Village on a sunny autumn afternoon.  ☕ SUPPORT THE CHANNEL  Enjoy our walks? title: Shinjuku Walking Tour 2026 | 4K Tokyo Walk
description: Immerse yourself in this stunning 4K, 60fps Tokyo walking tour, exploring the vibrant streets of Shinjuku, one of the busiest and most fascinating districts in Tokyo, Japan. Experience towering skyscrapers, bustling shopping streets, colorful neon signs, massive train stations, restaurants, entertainment districts, and the nonstop energy of modern Tokyo, with natural binaural sounds and immersive city ambience.  [CC] Turn ON Closed Captions to see location names, attractions, and historical facts throughout the walk.  🎧 Best experienced with headphones for a fully immersive ASMR 4K city walking tour with binaural street sounds.  Watch the full Japan Walking Tour Series: 👉 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL-uSE59HVj4Dlp9R19QBj1QrN9nLVNbQA  Explore Shinjuku, a dynamic district that perfectly captures the scale, energy, and diversity of Tokyo. Known for its massive transportation hub, shopping centers, office towers, department stores, restaurants, and entertainment districts, Shinjuku attracts millions of commuters, locals, and visitors every day.  This walking tour takes you through the lively streets surrounding Shinjuku Station, one of the world's busiest railway stations. The area around the station is filled with enormous commercial buildings, underground shopping areas, department stores, cafés, restaurants, and pedestrian streets, creating a constantly moving urban landscape.  As you explore Shinjuku, discover the contrast between its modern skyscrapers and smaller traditional streets. The district is home to Kabukicho, Tokyo's famous entertainment and nightlife area, as well as countless restaurants, bars, karaoke venues, arcades, and late-night establishments.  Shinjuku is also known for its impressive skyline. Towering buildings dominate the western side of the district, including the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building, while nearby streets offer countless perspectives of Tokyo's dense urban architecture and illuminated cityscape.  For a quieter experience, Shinjuku is also home to Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden, one of Tokyo's most beautiful green spaces. The expansive garden provides a peaceful contrast to the surrounding concrete jungle and is particularly famous for its seasonal scenery, including cherry blossoms in spring.  The history of Shinjuku is closely connected to Tokyo's growth as a major metropolitan center. What was once an important post-town along the historic Koshu Kaido route eventually developed into one of Japan's most important commercial and transportation hubs.  Today, Shinjuku represents many different sides of Tokyo at once—from business and shopping to food, entertainment, nightlife, and everyday city life. Its streets are always full of activity, with international visitors exploring temples and markets, browsing local shops and enjoying the town’s unique atmosphere. At the northern end of Goutama Street, we return to Ubud Main Street and walk west before heading into Ubud Art Market to take in more of the local shopping scene.  We then make our way back around Ubud Town Square and continue towards the northern section of Monkey Forest Street, where we wrap up our walking tour. title: London City Tour 2026 🇬🇧 | Borough Market, Tower Bridge & Tower of London [4K HDR]
description: LONDON, England Europe's Most Powerful Capital | 4K Walking Tour  Welcome to another London Walking Tour 2026, exploring some of the most famous and historic places in the heart of London. This 4K HDR walking tour takes you from the vibrant Borough Market through London Bridge and along the River Thames towards the iconic Tower Bridge and Tower of London.  Our walk begins at Borough Market, one of London’s best-known food markets. Explore the busy market atmosphere with visitors discovering street food, fresh produce, cafés, restaurants and historic market streets.  From Borough Market, we continue towards London Bridge, walking through one of the busiest areas of the city and passing London Bridge Station. This part of London combines modern architecture, historic streets and everyday city life.  The journey then takes us towards the Thames Riverside, where we enjoy beautiful views across the River Thames and London’s famous skyline. Walking beside the river is one of the best ways to experience this historic part of the capital.  We then approach the magnificent Tower Bridge, one of London’s most recognisable landmarks. Enjoy the impressive bridge, River Thames views, boats and the busy tourist atmosphere surrounding this iconic location.  The walk continues towards the historic Tower of London, completing a fantastic route through some of London’s most popular attractions.  🚶 Today’s Walking Route  Borough Market → London Bridge → London Bridge Station → Thames Riverside → Tower Bridge → Tower of London  This London City Tour 2026 captures everything from a famous food market and busy city streets to riverside scenery and some of London’s most historic landmarks. title: DÜSSELDORF, Germany 🇩🇪 This City Feels Expensive | 4K Walking Tour
description: This 4K Düsseldorf walking tour takes you through the historic center of Düsseldorf during a beautiful summer day, exploring charming Old Town streets, lively marketplaces, elegant boulevards, and some of the city's most famous landmarks. Filmed in real time with no music and no commentary, this immersive Düsseldorf city walk captures sunny weather, outdoor cafés, local life, and the relaxed atmosphere that makes summer one of the best times to visit the city.  In this video, I show you Düsseldorf Altstadt (Old Town), often called the "longest bar in the world" thanks to its countless pubs, breweries, restaurants, and lively streets. The historic center is full of character, with traditional architecture and busy outdoor terraces creating a classic Rhineland atmosphere.  You'll also see Bolkerstraße, the most famous street in the Old Town, known for its bars, breweries, nightlife, and vibrant street life. During summer, the entire area feels especially lively as locals and visitors fill the streets from morning until late evening.  The walk continues through Carlsplatz, Düsseldorf’s oldest marketplace, where local food vendors, fresh produce, cafés, and outdoor seating create one of the city's most authentic gathering places. Nearby streets such as Benrather Straße connect the historic center with the modern shopping districts.  One of the highlights is Königsallee, Germany’s most famous luxury boulevard. Walking along the beautiful Stadtgraben canal, lined with trees and elegant boutiques, offers a completely different atmosphere from the historic streets of the Old Town.  The tour finishes around Schadowstraße, one of Germany’s busiest shopping streets, where modern city life, retail stores, and summer crowds showcase another side of Düsseldorf.  This Düsseldorf 4K walking tour captures the perfect blend of historic charm, luxury shopping, local culture, and summer atmosphere.  🎥 Perfect for those searching for: Düsseldorf walking tour 4K, Düsseldorf summer walk, Düsseldorf Altstadt walk, Königsallee walking tour, Düsseldorf city center walk, Germany city walk, Carlsplatz market, Düsseldorf Old Town, Düsseldorf walking tour no commentary.  📍 Tour Highlights: ☀️ Düsseldorf Summer Atmosphere – Sunny streets and outdoor cafés 🏘️ Düsseldorf Altstadt – Historic Old Town 🍻 Bolkerstraße – Famous street with bars and breweries 🍓 Carlsplatz – Oldest marketplace in Düsseldorf 🌳 Stadtgraben – Beautiful canal along Königsallee 🛍️ Königsallee – Germany’s iconic luxury boulevard 🏙️ Schadowstraße – Major shopping street in Düsseldorf ✨ Historic & Modern Düsseldorf – Best of both worlds  🕒 Chapters: 0:00 Old Town, Düsseldorf Altstadt 6:19 Famous street with bars, Bolkerstraße 11:40 I continue in the Old Town 18:53 Carlsplatz, Oldest Marketplace in Düsseldorf 23:31 Benrather Straße 31:05 The Kö moat View, Stadtgraben 34:04 Königsallee 48:00 Düsseldorf City Center, Schadowstraße  🎬 Filming Info: 📍 Location: Düsseldorf, Germany 🇩🇪 📽️ Format: 4K Ultra HD at 60fps 🎧 Audio: Real city sounds – no music, no commentary ☀️ Season: Summer  🤝 Business Inquiries and Contact: walkingozmedia@gmail.com  ⚠️ My videos are copyrighted material owned by the channel Walking OZ. title: 🇹🇷Turkey Istanbul 4K Walking Tour 2026 | Karakoy to Eminonu by Galata Bridge Bosphorus Views & Foods
description: ''🇹🇷Turkey Istanbul 4K Walking Tour 2026 | Karakoy to Eminonu by Galata Bridge Bosphorus Views & Foods''  Experience one of the most iconic and dreamy walks in Istanbul, Turkey, in this immersive 4K walking tour across the famous Galata Bridge from Karaköy to Eminönü. Captured at golden hour time, this route shows the true heartbeat of Istanbul — crowded walkways, local fishermen, ferries crossing the water, street vendors, and the nonstop energy that makes this part of the city unforgettable. If you want to see real Istanbul street life with authentic sounds and atmosphere, this walk brings you directly into the center of it all.  Filmed in ultra-clear 4K, this tour showcases the stunning views of the Golden Horn and nearby Bosphorus scenery, where boats glide across the water, seagulls circle overhead, and the sea breeze mixes with the sounds of the city. Galata Bridge is one of the most famous and photographed locations in Istanbul specially for wedding photography, connecting the historic Old City with the modern and vibrant streets of Karaköy and Beyoğlu.  Throughout the walk, you’ll experience many of the things travelers search for most when visiting Istanbul: Galata Bridge views, Eminönü street life, Karaköy cafes, ferry culture, Istanbul waterfront atmosphere, Galata Tower views and the authentic rhythm of everyday life in Turkey. Crowds move constantly in both directions while locals shop, tourists explore, and fishermen line the bridge throughout the day, creating one of the most cinematic and lively scenes in the city.  Food culture is also an important part of this experience. The Galata Bridge area is especially famous for traditional fish sandwiches (balık ekmek), waterfront restaurants, tea shops, Turkish street food, and small local cafes near the harbor. Walking through this district gives you a true taste of Istanbul’s street culture, where food, history, and daily life blend together naturally.  This route is surrounded by some of Istanbul’s most visited attractions and neighborhoods. Nearby, you can explore Eminönü, the Spice Bazaar (Egyptian Bazaar), Sirkeci, Tahtakale, Karaköy streets, Galata Tower, and the Bosphorus waterfront. Many travelers include this exact walk in their Istanbul itinerary because it combines history, local culture, food, transportation, and incredible city views all in one route.  Transportation to this area is very easy using Istanbul’s public transport network. Eminönü is accessible by the T1 tram line, ferries from the Asian side, Marmaray connections through Sirkeci, and multiple bus routes. Karaköy also connects directly to tram lines, ferries, Galata, and Beyoğlu, making this one of the most connected and walkable areas in Istanbul. title: Stockholm, Sweden Walking Tour 4k - With Captions
description: Please check also our new channel:  youtube.com/@WalkingHunterTV We recorded this 4k ultra hd video during our trip to Stockholm, Sweden on Auguust 2024.  Welcome to Stockholm, the magnificent capital of Sweden, a city gracefully spread across 14 islands connected by over 50 bridges. Often called the "Venice of the North," Stockholm is renowned for its stunning waterfront setting, the incredibly well-preserved medieval old town (Gamla Stan), and its world-class museums and design scene. With a population of around one million in the city proper, Stockholm is the cultural, media, political, and economic center of Sweden. Sweden is a member of the European Union, but it does not use the Euro. The currency is the Swedish Krona (SEK). The official language is Swedish, with English being spoken fluently by a vast majority of the population. The city was founded around 1252, traditionally by the statesman Birger Jarl. It flourished as a trade hub within the Hanseatic League and became the capital of the powerful Swedish Empire in the 17th century. Stockholm is a very safe, clean, and innovative city. Note that Sweden is a largely cashless society, so credit/debit cards and digital payments are the preferred methods of payment almost everywhere. The public transport system (SL) is excellent, covering the metro (Tunnelbana), buses, trams, and ferries. A travel card is the most convenient way to get around. Don't leave without experiencing "fika," the beloved Swedish tradition of taking a break for coffee and a pastry. Be sure to try classic Swedish meatballs or a delicious cinnamon bun (kanelbulle). title: Kanazawa at 2:34 AM — Midnight Rain in Samurai & Geisha Districts [4K Binaural ASMR]
description: No talking. No music. No AI-generated sound. Only real rain and ambient sound, recorded on location in Kanazawa, Japan.  At 2:34:28 AM, this walk begins in Nagamachi. After the disclosed edit, it resumes in Nishi Chaya and returns toward the samurai district through the rain.  [A NOTE ABOUT THIS RECORDING]  Quiet Journey is built on one continuous, uncut recording. This night is a rare exception.  I became so absorbed in the rain-soaked beauty of Nagamachi that I lost sight of the starting point I had planned. To preserve both districts as one coherent record of that night, the two sections were reordered, with a single edit between them.  Both were recorded in Kanazawa on the same rainy night with real ambient sound. Nothing was staged or looped, and no sound was recreated or added afterward.  [ABOUT KANAZAWA]  Kanazawa grew as the castle town of the Maeda clan, rulers of the powerful Kaga Domain for more than 280 years. The domain was celebrated as “Kaga Hyakumangoku” — the land of one million koku.  Its wealth supported scholarship, tea culture, gardens and crafts. Kanazawa now produces approximately 99% of Japan’s gold leaf and has been a UNESCO Creative City of Crafts and Folk Art since 2009.  The modern city still follows much of the street and water network planned around Kanazawa Castle 400 years ago.  [NAGAMACHI SAMURAI DISTRICT]  Nagamachi was home mainly to middle- and high-ranking retainers, whose rank influenced the size of each residence, gate, garden and walls.  The district escaped major fires and wartime destruction. Its narrow lanes, earthen walls, wooden gates and waterways retain the scale of an Edo-period residential quarter.  Beside the walls flows the Onosho Canal, one of Kanazawa’s oldest waterways. It carried timber, tax rice and supplies toward Kanazawa Castle while providing household water and protection against fire.  In winter, straw mats called komo protect the earthen walls from frost, snow and cracking.  [NISHI CHAYA DISTRICT]  Nishi Chaya is one of Kanazawa’s three historic geisha districts, with Higashi Chaya and Kazuemachi. In 1820, teahouses scattered through central Kanazawa were moved into designated districts.  A chaya was not simply a tea shop, but an exclusive house where geisha performed music, dance and song.  Smaller and quieter than Higashi Chaya, Nishi Chaya’s historic street is only about 100 meters long. Traditional two-story wooden teahouses and fine latticework remain, and at certain hours a shamisen may still be heard behind the facades.  [KANAZAWA AND RAIN]  Kanazawa ranks among Japan’s rainiest cities. An old saying advises: “You may forget your lunch box, but never forget your umbrella.”  Rain feeds the canals, deepens the earthen walls and turns the stone lanes into reflections of the city’s lamps.  [SOUND]  Real binaural rain and environmental sound recorded on location. No music, narration or artificial ambience was added. Cars, footsteps, water and distant city sounds are part of the real night. Only sudden loud sounds may be reduced for comfort. Best experienced with headphones.  [VIDEO INFORMATION]  Location: Nagamachi Samurai District & Nishi Chaya District, Kanazawa, Ishikawa, Japan Start Time: 2:34:28 AM Duration: 1:09:43 Weather: Midnight rain Format: 4K / 24 fps / SDR Audio: Real binaural sound / 32-bit float / 48 kHz Editing: One disclosed edit between the two recorded sections  [GEAR]  Camera: Sony FX3A Lens: ZEISS Batis 25mm F2 Gimbal: DJI RS 5 Microphones: DPA 4560 CORE+ Recorder: Sound Devices MixPre-6 II  [PROJECT 47]  Part of an ongoing archive of real rain across all 47 prefectures of Japan — from famous cities to small villages, fishing ports and places few people visit. title: Tirana, Albania 🇦🇱 - Summer 2026 - 4K HDR Walking Tour
description: Tirana spent forty years sealed off. Albania under Enver Hoxha was the most isolated country in Europe, private cars were banned for ordinary citizens, and some 170,000 concrete bunkers were poured across the countryside against an invasion that never came.  What is left is a capital unlike any other in the region. In the early 2000s the mayor, a painter by training, started having the grey communist apartment blocks painted in bright colours, and the habit stuck. The city centre now mixes Ottoman-era mosques, Italian fascist-era ministries, Hoxha's pyramid mausoleum turned youth centre, and glass towers going up faster than the street plan can absorb. title: Why YOU SHOULD Visit Gibraltar!
description: What's it like in Gibraltar? Join me on a Tour of Gibraltar on Spain’s southern coast, a region well known for its towering rock and fascinating military history. The British Overseas Territory situated at the end of the Iberian Peninsula is dominated by the Rock of Gibraltar, famous for it's siege tunnels and it's monkeys (actually Barbary Macaques,) Although it covers less than 3 square miles, the strategic location of Gibraltar has made it one of the most fought over places in Europe. For centuries it has withstood political manoeuvring, sieges, battles and today, with its red call boxes, Union Jacks and high street shops, Gibraltar staunchly stands as a small pocket of England in the heart of the Mediterranean.   We start the tour in Casements Square and walk in to Gibraltar town centre towards Main Street, We the pass through Grand Casements Gates and cross the street to explore Ocean Village - The famous marina and site of many bars, restaurants and coffee shops. from there we explore the rock of Gibraltar and it's many attractions including :-  Apes' Den / Barbary Macaques - Gibraltar's wild monkeys in their natural habitat Gibraltar Nature Reserve, Upper Rock - Gibraltar's most prominent landmark and nature reserve Mediterranean Steps - UNESCO World Heritage Site Buffer Zone O'Hara's Battery - Highest point of the Rock of Gibraltar Skywalk - Glass lookout with spectacular views at the top of the Rock St Michael's Cave - A natural cave in the heart of the Rock Windsor Suspension Bridge - A suspension bridge - not for the faint hearted  I also check out the beaches of Gibraltar including  Camp Bay & Little Bay - A former quarry turned into a lido, and a little rocky beach by the cliffs Catalan Bay - A picturesque village by the sea located on the east side of the Rock Eastern Beach - Gibraltar's largest beach located adjacent to the airstrip Sandy Bay - A secluded beach with orange sand from the Sahara  And lastly Gibraltar Airport is listed as one of the most dangerous airports in the World. title: Relaxing Night Walk in Jordaan, Amsterdam • 4K Binaural
description: I walk around the Jordaan in Amsterdam at night, through quiet streets and past beautiful canals. The Jordaan is a beautiful neighborhood that was originally built in the 17th century as a working-class district, home to laborers and immigrants arriving in Amsterdam. The living conditions were harsh, with large families squeezed into the small houses that we now find so picturesque. Over time, the neighborhood became a refuge for struggling artists and those fleeing persecution. However, due to poor maintenance, conditions deteriorated further. By 1900, an estimated 80,000 people lived here, often without proper sanitation.  After World War II, there were even discussions about demolishing the Jordaan to make way for modern housing. Fortunately, it was preserved and gradually transformed into the beautifu, sought-after area it is today. What was once a poor neighborhood is now one of the most desirable - and expensive - places to live in Amsterdam. Finding accommodation here is difficult and comes with a high price tag, yet the streets still retain the character and history of their past. title: [4K] Leavenworth - German Bavarian Village - Washington USA - Walking Tour
description: Step into the enchanting world of Leavenworth, Washington, a picturesque Bavarian village nestled in the heart of the Cascade Mountains! 🏔️ Join us on a stunning 4K walking tour as we explore the charming streets, admire the unique architecture, and soak in the festive atmosphere.  Experience the magic of this German-inspired town, from its delightful shops and authentic eateries to the beautiful natural surroundings. Whether you're planning a visit or simply looking for a virtual escape, this video offers a serene journey through one of America's most charming destinations.  Don't forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more travel adventures!  Leavenworth is a city in Chelan County, Washington, United States. It is part of the Wenatchee−East Wenatchee Metropolitan Statistical Area. The population was 2,263 at the 2020 census. The entire town center is modeled on a German Bavarian village as part of a civic initiative that began in the 1960s.  Leavenworth was designed with an Alpine German theme from the 1960s onward, with most buildings modeled after Bavarian settlements and adopting stereotypical fonts and names. However the town retains wide streets and large parking lots which are atypical of Bavaria.[citation needed]. The Alpine German architectural theme is regulated by a design review board that approves plans for all new businesses, including chain establishments, leading to unusual designs for local fast-food restaurants and other retailers. Leavenworth's transformation into a theme town was inspired, and assisted, by Solvang, California. Later, the Washington town of Winthrop followed Leavenworth's example and adopted a Western town theme. title: 🇨🇳 Shenzhen, Walking in China's Most Futuristic City! (4K HDR)
description: Experience one of the world's most futuristic cities on this immersive 4K HDR walking tour of Shenzhen, China. From groundbreaking architecture and sprawling public parks to autonomous technology and one of the world's most impressive subway stations, this walk showcases why Shenzhen has become a global symbol of innovation.  The journey begins at Shenzhen Bay Culture Park, where the iconic white pebble-shaped buildings designed by MAD Architects rise organically from rolling green landscapes. Often compared to giant AirPods, these striking structures overlook beautifully designed public spaces filled with families, art installations, and sweeping views of Shenzhen's ever-growing skyline.  As we continue through the city, you'll discover a place where futuristic technology is part of everyday life. Watch delivery drones fly overhead carrying bubble tea, see robots working in public spaces, explore modern shopping districts, and experience how enormous parks blend seamlessly into one of the world's fastest-growing urban environments.  The walk continues through The Wave shopping district before arriving at Shenzhen's monumental civic center and the impressive Urban Planning Museum, a fitting showcase for a city that has transformed from a small fishing village into a global technology powerhouse in just a few decades.  The tour concludes inside the spectacular Gangxia North Metro Station, famous for its enormous sculptural ceiling and breathtaking sci-fi-inspired design. Often considered one of the world's most beautiful subway stations, it's the perfect finale to a city that constantly pushes the boundaries of architecture, urban planning, and technology.  Whether you're planning a trip to China or simply love exploring incredible cities from home, this walking tour offers a front-row seat to one of the most remarkable urban landscapes on Earth.  🎧 For the best experience, wear headphones. 📺 Filmed in stunning 4K HDR for maximum detail and realism.  ⏱️ Chapters  #Shenzhen #China #WalkingTour #ChinaTravel #4KHDR #CityWalk #Architecture #Travel #UrbanDesign #FutureCity

title: KUTA, Bali 4K Walking Tour 🌅 Kuta Beach, Beachwalk Mall & Kuta Square Afternoon Walk 2026
description: Kuta, Bali. Friday, 2 October 2026.  It’s late afternoon in Kuta, Bali. We then leave Beachwalk Mall and head onto Pantai Kuta Street. The pedestrian widening project along this road is still underway. The area directly in front of Beachwalk Mall already has a much wider pedestrian space, while the improvements continue further north and south along Pantai Kuta Street.  We walk south along the road, taking a look at the progress of the pedestrian improvements along the way.  We then turn east, passing the front of Truntum Hotel before reaching the intersection. From there, we turn right onto Bakungsari Street, an area also commonly known as Kuta Square.  Despite the warm afternoon sun, there are plenty of tourists out and about. Some are walking around the shops, while others are making their way towards the beach.  We continue along Bakungsari Street and reach part of Kartika Street, before turning around and heading into Kuta Art Market.  After exploring the market, we make our way towards Kuta Beach. By now, the sun is starting to turn orange, and the atmosphere on the beach is becoming much more relaxed. 🌅  Many tourists are enjoying the sand and the evening atmosphere, while others are sitting back with a drink along the beachfront near Truntum Hotel.  We continue north along the beachfront footpath, enjoying the changing colours of the sky and the lively atmosphere around Kuta Beach.  Finally, we reach the area near Kuta Beach Heritage Hotel and Mercure Hotel, where we finish today's walking tour.  From the busy streets of Kuta and ongoing pedestrian improvements to the golden evening light over Kuta Beach, this walk gives you a glimpse of Kuta as the afternoon slowly turns into sunset. title: Interlaken, Switzerland 4K Walking Tour | The Heart of the Swiss Alps 🇨🇭
description: For the best experience, turn on subtitles and select your native language to discover interesting facts and information throughout the walk. 🇨🇭  Welcome to Interlaken, one of Switzerland’s most famous destinations and the gateway to the breathtaking Bernese Oberland. Located between the turquoise waters of Lake Thun and Lake Brienz, Interlaken is surrounded by impressive Alpine scenery and offers some of the most iconic views in Switzerland.  In this relaxing 4K walking tour, we explore the charming streets, traditional Swiss architecture, beautiful parks, historic buildings and peaceful corners of this world-famous mountain town. From many places in Interlaken, you can enjoy spectacular views of the Jungfrau massif, including the famous peaks of Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau.  Interlaken has been an important tourist destination for more than 200 years. Its central location makes it the perfect starting point for exploring some of Switzerland’s most beautiful places, including Lauterbrunnen, Grindelwald, Wengen, Mürren and the Jungfrau region.  One of the most recognizable places in town is the Höhematte, a large open meadow in the heart of Interlaken. It offers unobstructed views toward the mountains and is also a popular landing area for paragliders. On clear days, you can often watch dozens of colourful paragliders floating above the town before landing directly in the centre.  Interlaken is also known as Switzerland’s adventure capital. Visitors come here for paragliding, hiking, canyoning, rafting, skydiving, skiing and countless other outdoor activities. At the same time, the town is equally enjoyable for those who simply want to relax, walk along the river, explore local shops or enjoy the peaceful Alpine atmosphere.  The town is divided by the Aare River, which connects Lake Brienz and Lake Thun. Its striking turquoise colour comes from fine glacial sediments carried down from the surrounding mountains. The combination of turquoise water, traditional Swiss houses and dramatic mountain peaks creates some of the most beautiful scenery in the region.  Interlaken has two main railway stations: Interlaken Ost and Interlaken West. Interlaken Ost is especially important for travellers heading into the Jungfrau region, with direct connections toward Lauterbrunnen and Grindelwald. Thanks to Switzerland’s excellent public transport system, many of the surrounding valleys, mountain villages and viewpoints can easily be reached without a car.  Another popular attraction is Harder Kulm, Interlaken’s local mountain. A funicular takes visitors from near Interlaken Ost up to an altitude of around 1,322 metres, where a viewing platform offers panoramic views over Interlaken, Lake Thun, Lake Brienz and the surrounding Alpine peaks.  Despite being one of Switzerland’s most visited destinations, Interlaken still has many peaceful streets and quiet corners away from the busiest tourist areas. Walking through the town is one of the best ways to experience its unique mix of Alpine scenery, historic tourism tradition and modern Swiss lifestyle.  Sit back, relax and enjoy this peaceful 4K walking tour through Interlaken, Switzerland. title: Summer Bird Photography - Sigma 150-600mm & Canon M50 Nature Walk
description: Come along for a relaxing summer bird photography walk with my Canon M50 and Sigma 150-600mm lens🌿📸  Back at one of my favorite parks, this day felt like stepping into a dream. title: Midnight Rain Walk in a Mt. Fuji Town — Fujiyoshida, Japan [4K]
description: No talking. No music. Just real ambient sound.  A quiet midnight rain walk through Fujiyoshida, Yamanashi, Japan — a town located near Mt. Fuji.  This walk moves through Kanpai-dori Alley and the Fujiyoshida Retro Shopping Street, passing narrow backstreets, old storefronts, small signs, lanterns, and quiet local nightlife alleys after midnight.  Fujiyoshida is often known as one of the gateway towns to Mt. Fuji. During the day, some of its old streets and shopping areas are connected with views toward the mountain, but after midnight, the atmosphere becomes completely different — quiet, wet, empty, and still.  In this video, the rain becomes light at times, but the wet pavement, soft reflections, closed storefronts, and warm streetlights remain throughout the route, creating a calm rainy-night feeling in the old alleys of Fujiyoshida.  Nothing is staged. No narration, no music, and no cuts — just the real sound and presence of the place.  Real ambient sound (ASMR). Best experienced with headphones.  Uncut. title: GENEVA SWITZERLAND 🇨🇭 Central Streets Walking tour in World’s smallest metropolis 4K asmr
description: Geneva is Switzerland’s most cosmopolitan city. Here is where the United Nations European headquarters and the Red Cross are based. The city on Lake Geneva is also the cradle of watchmaking and home to many chocolatiers. Geneva has many sights, including the Jet d’Eau fountain, the flower clock L’horloge fleurie, the old town with the St. Pierre Cathedral and the Place du Bourg-de-Four.  Geneva is Switzerland’s most international city, as it is where the European seat of the UNO is based. Even the International Red Cross directs its humanitarian campaigns from here. Besides being a congress city, Geneva is also a centre for culture and history, for trade fairs and exhibitions. The «Horloge Fleuri», the large flower clock in the “Jardin Anglais” (English Garden), is a world-renowned symbol of the Geneva watch industry.  Geneva is considered the second largest city in Switzerland and also the smallest metropolis in the world, home to 200,000 people. Most of the large hotels and many restaurants are situated on the right-hand shore of the lake. The old town, the heart of Geneva with the shopping and business quarter, holds sway over the left-hand shore. Quays, lakeside promenades, countless parks, lively side streets in the old town and elegant shops invite guests to stroll. One of the best-maintained streets is the Grand-Rue, where Jean-Jacques Rousseau was born. The «mouettes», a type of water taxi, enable crossings to be made from one lakeshore to the other, while larger vessels invite visitors to enjoy cruises on Lake Geneva.  Culturally, this city on the westernmost fringe of Switzerland has much to offer. International artists perform in the Grand Théâtre and Geneva Opera House, and an extremely diverse range of museums such as the “Musée international de l'horlogerie”, a watch museum with a collection of jewellery watches and musical clocks, and the International Museum of the Red Cross and Red Crescent, which provides an insight into the work of these humanitarian organisations, invite city guests to visit them.  Geneva lies idyllically between Alpine peaks and vineyards by the largest lake in Western Europe. title: GENEVA Switzerland 📍 Alpine Luxury by the Lake 4K Walking Tour asmr
description: Geneva, the birthplace of watchmaking The first major Swiss watchmakers emerged in the 16th century, turning Geneva into the cradle of watchmaking. At the time, following the reform of John Calvin, the people of Geneva had to follow a strict dress code and dress as simply as possible. Nevertheless, they refused to get rid of all their finery and kept buying watches. To meet this demand, jewellers thus turned to watchmaking.   This is how the art of watchmaking was born in Geneva. Blending tradition and precision, the city has since become the symbol of fine watchmaking.  The Jet d'Eau – a water fountain born by chance The 140-metre tall  Jet d'Eau has become one of Geneva's best-known symbols over the years, but Geneva's famous landmark was almost born out of coincidence.   In 1886, the waterworks that distributed the motive power of the Rhône to Geneva's craftspeople and watchmakers was forced to create an open outlet for the water when the workshops closed at night. That outlet became the famous water fountain, arousing the enthusiasm of locals and visitors alike.  #schweiz #downtown #shopping #town #city #switzerland #walk #walking #stadt #city #tour #4k #travel #Suisse #asmr #swiss #svizzera #wander #Suiza #luxury #street #alps #life #ambient #sound #geneva #tourism #beautiful #place #video #youtube #genf

title: COLOGNE, Germany 🇩🇪 This City is Underestimated | 4K Walking Tour
description: This 4K Cologne walking tour takes you through the heart of Cologne (Köln), Germany, exploring famous shopping streets, historic landmarks, lively squares, and some of the city's most iconic locations. Filmed in real time with no music and no commentary, this immersive Cologne city walk captures the vibrant atmosphere of one of Germany’s most visited cities.  In this video, I show you the magnificent Cologne Cathedral (Kölner Dom), one of the most famous landmarks in Europe and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Towering above the city skyline, the cathedral is the symbol of Cologne and one of the largest Gothic churches in the world.  The walk continues along Hohe Straße and Schildergasse, two of Germany’s busiest shopping streets, filled with shops, cafés, restaurants, and constant city life. These pedestrian zones form the commercial heart of Cologne and attract millions of visitors every year.  Along the way, I also explore smaller city center streets and hidden corners that reveal a different side of Cologne beyond the major tourist attractions. The mix of historic buildings, modern shops, and local atmosphere makes the city especially enjoyable to explore on foot.  Later, the tour reaches Hahnentorburg at Rudolfplatz, one of Cologne’s historic medieval city gates and an important reminder of the city’s long history. The walk then continues through Hohenzollernring and Ehrenstraße, popular areas known for shopping, cafés, restaurants, and vibrant urban life.  This Cologne 4K walking tour captures the perfect mix of history, architecture, shopping, and everyday city atmosphere in one of Germany’s most iconic destinations.  🎥 Perfect for those searching for: Cologne walking tour 4K, Köln city walk, Cologne Cathedral walk, Cologne city center, Hohe Straße Cologne, Schildergasse walking tour, Cologne Germany sightseeing, Cologne Old Town, Germany walking tour no commentary.  📍 Tour Highlights: ⛪ Cologne Cathedral (Kölner Dom) – Iconic Gothic landmark 🛍️ Hohe Straße – Famous shopping street 🏙️ Schildergasse – One of Germany’s busiest pedestrian streets 🏛️ Hahnentorburg – Historic medieval city gate 🚶 Rudolfplatz – Important square in central Cologne ☕ Ehrenstraße – Popular cafés, restaurants, and boutiques ✨ Cologne City Center – Historic landmarks and modern city life  🕒 Chapters: 0:00 Cologne Cathedral 3:14 Hohe Str. 11:18 Schildergasse & City Center Side Streets 35:50 Hahnentor Gate & Rudolfplatz 38:51 Hohenzollernring & Ehrenstraße  🎬 Filming Info: 📍 Location: Cologne (Köln), Germany 🇩🇪 📽️ Format: 4K Ultra HD at 60fps 🎧 Audio: Real city sounds – no music, no commentary ☀️ Time: Daytime  🤝 Business Inquiries and Contact: walkingozmedia@gmail.com  ⚠️ My videos are copyrighted material owned by the channel Walking OZ. Finally, our walk wraps up at the legendary Jongno 3-ga Pocha Street, an authentic Korean outdoor tent market bursting with sizzling street food, dynamic conversations, and incredible street energy. description: Explore Sirkeci, Istanbul in this immersive 4K walking tour through one of the busiest and most flavorful parts of Istanbul’s Old City. title: Dubrovnik Croatia 🇭🇷 4K Old Town Beach and Walls Walking Tour
description: This is a walking tour in Dubrovnik, Croatia going through the Old Town, the city walls, the 2 nearby beaches and finally a evening tour of the Old Town. Dubrovnik is a picturesque city located on the southern coast of Croatia, along the Adriatic Sea. It is renowned for its well-preserved medieval architecture and fortified walls, which have earned it a spot on the UNESCO World Heritage list. The city's historical significance dates back to the 7th century when it was established as a major maritime and trading center. Over the centuries, Dubrovnik flourished as the Republic of Ragusa, known for its diplomacy, trade, and cultural contributions.  Today, Dubrovnik is a popular tourist destination, attracting visitors from around the world with its stunning landscapes, azure waters, and rich history. The city's Old Town is a maze of narrow streets and squares, home to significant landmarks such as the Rector's Palace, Sponza Palace, and the iconic Onofrio's Fountain.  Dubrovnik's natural beauty and cultural heritage have also made it a popular filming location for various movies and TV shows, including the famous TV series "Game of Thrones." Apart from exploring historical sites, visitors can enjoy various outdoor activities like swimming, sailing, and exploring nearby islands.  With its blend of history, stunning architecture, and coastal charm, Dubrovnik continues to be an enchanting destination that captivates travelers from all walks of life. title: Switzerland’s Most Beautiful Off-Grid Village 🇨🇭 Foroglio | Fairytale Walking Tour

title: Zhouzhuang, China's Timeless Water Town - A Mesmerizing 4K Walking Journey Through History
description: Welcome to one of China’s most beautiful water towns. As I walk deeper into the town, the slow rhythm of life reveals itself — boats drifting along the water, lanterns hanging from old buildings, and reflections shimmering beneath centuries-old bridges.  This peaceful walk captures the atmosphere of a place where history and daily life blend together. title: Jomtien Night Walk | Rompho, Soi 7, Dongtan Beach & Supertown | 4K HDR POV
description: This Jomtien night walk starts with a loop through the Rompho Bar Area, then continues through several popular streets and beach areas toward Supertown. From Rompho, we cross Jomtien Second Road and walk through Soi 7. We then enter Soi 8, which is a dead-end soi, so we turn around and return to the beach. We continue along Jomtien Beach Road toward Dongtan Beach, where we stop to look at the ongoing work to add more sand to the beach. From Dongtan, we continue through a small lane with bars toward Jomtien Supertown. After walking through Supertown, we exit onto Thappraya Road, where the walk ends.
